status_summary: No transfer of Secret Service financial or cyber investigations to Justice or Treasury, and no field office closure plan, was found. CRS analysis of the FY2027 DHS budget request (dated 2026-06-09) describes a Secret Service request of 3.45 billion dollars that adds 520 special agent, 256 Uniformed Division and 50 technical law enforcement positions: the Uniformed Division increase is a proposal that aligns with the Mandate's staffing item, while the agent growth points to the existing dual-mission structure continuing. On visitor logs, a February 2025 news report quoted a White House official as saying visitor logs would not be released in the second term; the Mandate's ask concerns the Secret Service keeping logs, which the sources do not address.
